statement: Each child has a greed factor: greed[i] is the smallest cookie size that will make child i content. Each cookie has a size given in cookies.
Each child can get at most one cookie, and each cookie can go to at most one child. A child is content if the cookie they get has size ≥ their greed factor.
Return the largest number of children that can be made content.

examples.explanation: Both cookies have size 1, so only the child with greed 1 can be made content.
Give the size-1 cookie to the child with greed 1 and the size-2 cookie to the child with greed 2. Both children are content.

Handing out cookies in the order given would give the size-2 cookie to the child who needs 1, leaving only a size-1 cookie for the child who needs 2. Matching sizes to needs instead - 1 to the first child, 2 to the second - satisfies both.
